name: claude-seo
description: Universal SEO skill for Claude Code. 25 sub-skills + 18 sub-agents covering technical SEO, E-E-A-T, schema, GEO/AEO, backlinks, local SEO, maps intelligence, semantic clustering, e-commerce SEO, international SEO, Google APIs, and PDF/Excel reporting. Optional DataForSEO, Firecrawl, and Banana extensions.
readme_summary: Claude SEO is an open-source plugin for Claude Code that performs comprehensive SEO analysis. It leverages 25 sub-skills and 18 specialist agents to cover a wide range of SEO aspects, providing prioritized, actionable recommendations grounded in primary-source guidance.
key_features: Comprehensive SEO analysis (technical, E-E-A-T, schema, GEO, local, e-commerce, international)
25 sub-skills and 18 specialist agents for parallel execution
Prioritized action plans with testable recommendations
AI-search optimization aligned with Google's AI Optimization Guide
Falsifiable recommendations with first-principle observations and explicit failure checks
Optional DataForSEO, Firecrawl, and Banana extensions
Public open-source MIT license version available
Community private mirror with early access for members
primary_use_case: To provide automated, in-depth SEO audits and actionable recommendations within the Claude Code environment, helping users improve their website's search engine performance.
cover_image_prompt: A wise, ancient librarian meticulously organizing a vast, glowing library of digital information. The librarian is using a magical magnifying glass to examine individual books (representing web pages), identifying specific glowing symbols (representing SEO elements like schema, E-E-A-T, backlinks) and sorting them into categorized shelves. Input scrolls of raw data are being transformed into neatly organized, illuminated output shelves. Subtle UI elements of the Claude Code command palette are visible on a nearby desk. The scene is set in a dimly lit, mystical study with warm, focused lighting on the librarian and shelves. The style is a 3D isometric illustration with rich details and a color scheme of deep blues, golds, and glowing whites.

name: gobackup
description: 🗄 CLI tool for backup your databases, files to cloud storages in schedully.
readme_summary: GoBackup is a Go-based CLI tool designed for application servers to automate the backup of databases and files. It securely stores these backups in various cloud storage services with scheduled execution and optional encryption and compression.
key_features: No dependencies
Multiple Databases source support
Multiple Storage type support
Archive paths or files into a tar
Split large backup file into multiple parts
Run as daemon to backup in schedully
Web UI to manage backups
Notifier support (Mail, Webhook, Discord, Slack, etc.)
primary_use_case: Automating scheduled backups of databases and files to cloud storage for application servers.
cover_image_prompt: A diligent digital librarian meticulously organizing and safeguarding precious books (representing databases and files) within a vast, secure cloud library. The librarian is shown carefully placing a book into a glowing portal that leads to different cloud storage icons (S3, GCS, FTP). Subtle digital particles representing data flow surround the scene, and a small, unobtrusive clock icon indicates scheduled operations. The overall mood is one of security and reliability, with a clean, modern aesthetic. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a vibrant yet organized color palette, emphasizing the seamless transfer and storage of data.

name: stealth-browser-mcp
description: The only browser automation that bypasses anti-bot systems. AI writes network hooks, clones UIs pixel-perfect via simple chat.
readme_summary: Stealth Browser MCP is a Python library designed for advanced browser automation, specifically engineered to bypass anti-bot systems and CAPTCHAs. It leverages AI to automate network requests and replicate user interfaces with high fidelity, enabling seamless web scraping and interaction with protected websites.
key_features: Bypasses anti-bot systems and Cloudflare challenges
AI-driven network hook generation
Pixel-perfect UI cloning via chat commands
Utilizes nodriver and Chrome DevTools Protocol
MCP-compatible for AI agent integration
primary_use_case: To enable AI agents and automated scripts to interact with websites that employ sophisticated anti-bot measures, such as Cloudflare, by providing an undetectable browser automation solution.
cover_image_prompt: A skilled digital locksmith, represented as an AI avatar, is effortlessly picking a complex, glowing lock shaped like a CAPTCHA symbol. The lock is integrated into a digital wall representing a website's defenses. From the locksmith's hands, streams of data flow, seamlessly reconstructing a perfect replica of a user interface on the other side of the wall. Subtle network lines and code snippets are visible in the background, hinting at the underlying technology. The overall mood is one of sophisticated problem-solving and seamless access. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a futuristic, clean aesthetic, emphasizing the AI's intelligence and the bypass mechanism.
